text:
Celine: Quick heads-up — CI flagged a BLEU drop on the new Pixel-Bridge bring-up when going q5 -> int8 for mixed zh-Hant + ja ruby/vertical samples. baseline=29.8 -> current=24.1 :thinking_face:

ModelCI: run #4821 finished. delta -5.7 BLEU. Artifact: /artifacts/pixel-bridge/4821/report.html. Suspect tokenization boundary shifts around ruby anchors and narrow spaces.

Anya: Can someone paste a minimal repro sample and the tokenized output? I want to reproduce locally.

Rohit: pasted gist with samples and token dumps https://gist.github.com/rohit/pixel-bridge-repro — includes 6 failing sentences and token ids.

Anya: quick local smoke: int8 quant + current tokenizer repros the drop. Diff shows extra token insertion after U+303B and before ruby start markers. Example tokenized lines:

```
before: [1023, 4501, 78, 9002, 33]
after : [1023, 4501, 4003, 78, 9002, 33]
note: 4003 corresponds to ZWSP-like insertion from new normalizer
```

Kai: We merged the hybrid-ruby normalizer last week (commit 9f2d3a4) to heuristically insert ZWSP for readability.

Celine: Canary prior to that tokenizer change passed. ModelCI bisect points at 9f2d3a4 as likely culprit.

ModelCI: bisect ranking: commit 9f2d3a4 -> probability 73% that tokenizer change is root cause.

Rohit: running a revert test now (revert normalizer commit) on int8 canary. ETA ~8m.

Sana: flagging customer impact: some subtitle rendering pipelines on Dedicated use these ruby patterns. If regression persists, we may need a quick rollback on canary.

Rohit: revert result: BLEU ~29.6 (within noise). Revert + int8 removes the regression.

Anya: so it's an interaction: tokenizer normalization + quantized weights. Need to either adjust normalizer to preserve ruby anchors or make tokenization id-stable under normalization.

Kai: proposed plan:
1) revert hybrid-ruby normalizer on canary immediately
2) open a follow-up PR to modify normalizer to skip insertion when ruby anchors detected
3) add a locale-ci test that runs quantized pipeline on ruby+vertical samples to catch this going forward

Celine: +1. Also add a tiny integration test that runs the quantized runtime path in CI (fast subset) so quantization+tokenization interactions fail fast.

ModelCI: created incident INC-4821 and assigned to Kai + Anya. Link: https://redwood.incid/INC-4821. Priority: medium.

Anya: I will draft the PR with the failing unit and a minimal int8 repro harness. @Rohit can you run perf regression after the token fix?

Rohit: will run perf bench and sanity checks after PR.

Celine: thanks team. Keep updates in this thread. If we need to rollback in prod, loop in eng-oncall and support.

Kai: adding TODO — update docs for tokenizer normalizer rules and add comment about ruby anchors so future authors don't reintroduce this behavior.

Sana: noted. I will ping affected CSMs after we confirm rollback plan or fix.
